meta.title: Fisch locations data
notes: Scope is durable route anchors from Fisch Wiki location navigation and internal location pages.
Limited-time events, templates, generic mechanics pages, and tiny fish-pool-only rows are intentionally excluded.
Images are intentionally empty for this pass because clean row-level screenshots were inconsistent across location pages.

items.name: Moosewood
items.access: New-player spawn in the middle of the map.
items.keyContent: Merchant, Appraiser, Angler, Innkeeper, Shipwright, Pierre, Phineas, Lantern Keeper, and village services.
items.notableFishRewards: Starter pond and island fish, including Whisker Bill and Treble Bass on the source page.
items.routeUse: Use as the first selling, appraising, quest, spawn, and boat unlock hub.
items.cardSummary: The main starter island with early shops, appraising, Angler quests, spawn setting, and boat access.
items.sourceNote: Source page identifies Moosewood as the first island and lists core NPCs and starter fish.
